name: SoCo
summary: SoCo is a stylish lifestyle center featuring a distinct collection of home décor, fashion, and design retailers, anchored by The OC Mix with over 20 unique food and retail tenants. With exceptional 405 freeway visibility and exclusive Southern California locations for several tenants, it has become Costa Mesa's premier destination for curated shopping and dining.
demographics: SoCo attracts an affluent, design-conscious demographic primarily consisting of homeowners and professionals aged 30-55 with above-average household incomes. The trade area draws from Costa Mesa's creative class and surrounding Orange County communities, with visitors seeking unique home décor, fashion, and artisanal dining experiences. The center appeals to style-savvy shoppers who prefer curated, boutique retail over traditional mall environments, with strong weekend traffic from couples and families exploring the distinctive mix of local and specialty retailers.
description: The SoCo Collection represents Costa Mesa's premier lifestyle destination, offering a carefully curated mix of top retailers specializing in home décor, fashion, and design. This stylish, rustic space has become a cornerstone of Orange County's creative community, housing a variety of local retailers from quaint eateries to sophisticated design stores. At the heart of the property lies The OC Mix, an innovative indoor shopping and dining experience featuring over 20 unique food, drink, and retail tenants that create a vibrant social atmosphere. The center's strategic location along the 405 freeway provides exceptional visibility with 340,000 average annual daily traffic, offering tenants an unparalleled marketing window that drives strong sales performance. SoCo has distinguished itself by securing exclusive Southern California locations for several of its tenants, making it a must-visit destination for shoppers seeking one-of-a-kind retail experiences unavailable elsewhere in the region.
